note: INSTAT quarterly bulletin; its digitalisation diagnostic (EDIGSSN-2026) scores the national statistical system's structures, which are central bodies and the state's regional planning and statistics directorates (DRPSIAP), not local governments. Communes and collectivités territoriales appear as study sites, meeting participants, a 5 per cent source of those structures' IT budgets and the subject of decentralisation indicators. Nothing on local government offices' own connection.
